description: Random two-state generator: every new sample the output is drawn high or low, giving digital noise at audio rates and unpredictable gates at slow rates

params.text: Sets how often a new state is drawn
Attenuverter for the S. Rate CV input, -1 to +1, and zero at startup, so that input does nothing until this is turned up
Sets the chance that a new sample comes out high; fully anticlockwise never goes high and fully clockwise always does
Attenuverter for the Probability CV input, -1 to +1, and zero at startup, so that input does nothing until this is turned up
Fast runs the generator across its full rate range; Slow divides that rate by 100 for modulation speeds
Stepped snaps between the two states; Slewed interpolates linearly between them, which gives a smooth modulation source
Bipolar swings between -5V and 5V; Unipolar gives 0-10V

inputs.text: A rising edge here draws one new state, replacing the internal rate clock
Modulates the rate, scaled by the S. Rate attenuverter
Modulates the probability, scaled by the Probability attenuverter

notes: the generation rate is set as a fraction of the patch's own sample rate, so changing the patch's sample rate changes the speed and the sound of what comes out.
